home.title: Vime: an offline Japanese keyboard
home.description: Vime is a fully offline Japanese keyboard for iOS with romaji and 12-key kana layouts. Conversion, correction and suggestions all run on your device.
home.tagline: A fully offline Japanese keyboard for iOS
home.intro: Type in romaji or on a 12-key kana pad. Conversion, correction and suggestions all happen on your device.

points.title: Your typing stays on your device
points.text: Conversion, correction, learning and suggestions all run locally. Vime contains no networking code.

points.title: Two Japanese layouts
points.text: Full romaji QWERTY, or a 12-key kana pad with flick and toggle input.

points.title: Candidates that read the context
points.text: A local language model ranks candidates using the preceding text, then suggests the next word.

home.privacy_text: No account, no ads, no tracking.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.note: This page matches the released version of Vime.

status.title: Version status
status.next_note: Next version on the dev branch
rhythm: Changes are merged into the development branch at any time.
**Tuesday to Thursday 19:00 UTC** (Wednesday to Friday 03:00 in Beijing): when the development branch has new changes, a beta is built and uploaded to TestFlight, once a day.
Wednesday to Friday: the latest TestFlight build is checked and the release notes are written.
**Saturday 02:00 UTC** (10:00 in Beijing): the checked build is submitted for App Store review and released automatically once approved.
